usageNotes: Use this endpoint to generate a new auto-install token that PDM's automated installer can use to authenticate against the datacenter manager. Requires the System.Modify privilege on the system/auto-installation path. The secret returned in the response is shown only once — store it immediately, as it cannot be retrieved again.

examples.summary: Create a short-lived auto-install token for a staging deployment

params.comment: Staging auto-install token for June 2026 rollout

tips: The `secret` field in the response is the raw token secret and is only returned at creation time — there is no retrieval endpoint; save it to a secrets manager immediately.
Set `expire-at` to a Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch) for time-bounded deployments; use 0 or omit the field for a non-expiring token.
Token `id` must start with an alphanumeric character or underscore and may contain dots, hyphens, and underscores; it must be 3–64 characters.
Tokens created here are scoped to auto-installation workflows and are distinct from user API tokens managed under /access/users.
